title: 名单
beat: 钩子：女儿当街质问 → 反转：名单是他自己划掉的 → 悬念：他转身就走，不肯说原因

shots.note: HOOK - open on the accusation, no establishing shot
shots.action: {mei} stares straight past the camera, eyes wet and angry, jaw tight
shots.light: Cold blue dusk light with a warm street-lamp rim on her hair

dialogue.text: 爸，厂里的名单上，为什么没有你的名字？

shots.action: {chen} holds a chipped white enamel mug in both hands, eyes lowered, saying nothing
shots.motion: {chen} keeps his eyes down, swallows, and slowly lowers the enamel mug a little
shots.light: Warm street-lamp rim light from behind
shots.sound: quiet evening street, a distant bicycle bell

shots.note: insert - the prop that names the show
shots.action: Extreme close view of the weathered hands of {chen} gripping a chipped white enamel mug, knuckles pale, the navy sleeve cuffs visible, no face in frame
shots.motion: The weathered hands tighten around the chipped white enamel mug, the knuckles turning pale
shots.sound: faint creak of fingers on enamel, quiet street

shots.action: {chen} lifts his eyes and looks straight ahead, calm and resolved
shots.light: Warm street-lamp rim light from behind

shots.note: shock beat - the classic crash zoom
shots.motion: {mei} freezes, her eyes widen in disbelief and her lips part slightly
shots.sound: a sudden low thud, then silence

shots.note: CLIFFHANGER - he walks away, the line plays over his back
shots.action: {chen}, seen from behind, walks away down the middle of the empty street, the enamel mug hanging from one hand
shots.motion: {chen} walks slowly away from the camera down the empty wet street and does not look back
shots.light: The single yellow street lamp ahead of him, deep blue dusk
shots.sound: slow footsteps on wet stone, wind

dialogue.text: 有些事，你还是不知道的好。
